messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering anomaly detected — token_count drift >6% vs shadow_agg for region=us-west. Alerts at 2026-03-17T09:12:25Z. Possible delayed emitter deliveries. Paging miguel_oncall.

miguel_oncall: on it. acked. standing up triage channel.

emma_sre: pinging the metering pipeline dashboards now, checking emitter consumer lag and Kafka offsets.

miguel_oncall: quick ask — any customer-facing overage flags firing yet?

anita_prod: we have a handful of customers with auto-overage flags in the last 30m, not widespread: cust:acme-inc, cust:brightapp. I'm pausing automatic billing notifications for those accounts. :no_bell:

devon: noted. running quick query to compare upstream emitter counts vs internal tally.
```sql
-- compare raw emitter events vs billed tokens in 5m windows
SELECT window_start, sum(emitter_tokens) AS emitter, sum(billed_tokens) AS billed
FROM metering.windows
WHERE region='us-west' AND window_start >= '2026-03-17T08:30:00Z'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 12;
```

devon: results show emitter > billed by ~7-9% across 3 recent windows. suggests downstream ingestion/backfill lag, not double-count.

emma_sre: consumer_offsets: topic metering.emitter.partitions show lag spike ~120k messages starting 09:05Z. looks like a paused consumer group during a rolling deploy. check consumer group 'metering-ingest-usw'.

miguel_oncall: can we safely scale an ingest replica to drain? any risk of dupes?

emma_sre: scaling one extra consumer should be safe — we dedupe on event_id in the ingest layer. deploying now.

ops-bot: deploy job started: ci/metering-ingest/scale-up #463 by emma_sre at 2026-03-17T09:18:10Z

emma_sre: scaled +1, monitoring offsets... lag decreasing; consumer lag down to ~15k after 2min.

devon: re-running window compare — gaps shrinking. predicted reconciliation to finish in ~8-12m.

anita_prod: customer-impact note: paused billing emails for flagged accounts. recommended comms: short note to cs with expected reconciliation ETA and assurance we will not bill duplicates. draft: "We're investigating delayed usage reports; we paused automated overage emails and will reconcile within 2 hours. No duplicate charges expected."

miguel_oncall: agreed. tagging cs and trust. @anita_prod, send via the incident template when you have ETA.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=high, service=metering.ingest, incident_id=INC-20260317-21

emma_sre: background: we saw a deploy to metering-ingest at 09:04Z which briefly stalled one consumer (OOM-ish), autoscaler didn't add a pod fast enough. scaling fixed but backlog produced delayed emits which then caused shadow vs billed drift and pulled overage signals.

miguel_oncall: next steps: 1) keep extra consumer running until backlog is cleared + 5m, 2) run reconciliation job to apply late tokens to billing ledger without duplicating, 3) status update to stakeholders at 09:45Z, 4) prepare postmortem.

devon: kicking off reconciliation job: `jobs/reconcile/emit-diff --region=us-west --max-windows=60`

ops-bot: job reconcile/emit-diff started by devon at 2026-03-17T09:22:30Z

anita_prod: CS notified with the draft and ETA 09:50Z. they asked for a customer list — sending soon.

miguel_oncall: if reconciliation confirms late tokens, we'll mark the affected windows as backfilled and suppress auto-overage flags retroactively. make sure the billing-validator heartbeat is green after write.

emma_sre: consumer lag at ~2k now, reconciliation progress 30% (30/100 windows).

devon: reconcile job logs: "applied 1.2M tokens across 32 windows; no duplicate event_ids found; ledger write ok."

anita_prod: CS acked, will inform customers once ledger write completes. thanks. :white_check_mark:

miguel_oncall: preparing handoff — I'm keeping the channel until we confirm final ledger state and all flags cleared. if cleared by 09:50Z I'll hand to next oncall (emma) for follow-up and postmortem.

incident-bot: annotation: mitigation in progress, mitigation_owner=miguel_oncall

emma_sre: final check at 09:49Z — billing-validator heartbeat green, no new overage emails, shadow vs billed within 0.5% last 3 windows.

miguel_oncall: confirmed resolved at 09:50Z. removing extra consumer after 5m grace. creating follow-up ticket for root cause (OOM on deploy + autoscaler tuning).

anita_prod: sent closure note to CS and listed customers; telling them reconciliation complete and no duplicate charges.

miguel_oncall: handing off to emma_sre for postmortem write-up. thanks team. :bow:
